nonEolVersions.summary: The actual public-baseline Flask derivation runs uv 0.13.5 with CPython 3.14.8. Upstream currently releases the 0.13 line (latest observed 0.13.7), defines patch changes as non-breaking and minor changes as breaking, and lists Python 3.14 as continuously tested Tier 1. This demonstrates a maintained tool/runtime point under the bounded criterion. No inspected primary policy says a newer patch makes 0.13.5 EOL. This claim covers the executed 0.13.5/3.14.8 tuple only; it does not claim every patch, the full Python-version matrix, or execution of 0.13.7/Python 3.15 from an unmerged producer change.

primaryPolicyAdjudication.scopeOfNegativeFinding: No latest-patch-only maintenance or patch-specific EOL rule appears in these inspected primary policies; no claim about all possible unpublished policies.
